description: Eastern Province - By-Laws relating to the Nintavur Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content establishes new by-laws to regulate, control, and supervise advertisements within the Nintavur Pradeshiya Sabha area. It creates a comprehensive regulatory framework including licensing requirements, fee structures, display restrictions, and enforcement mechanisms. This falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it constitutes subsidiary legislation and regulatory requirements rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
